summary: List methods add, remove, replace, and search items. Use them when the number of items changes while the program runs.
notes: append() adds to the end. insert(0, item) adds at the front and shifts everything else right.
pop() removes and returns the last item. pop(0) removes the first.
remove(value) deletes only the first matching value.
pitfall: playlist.remove("Hello") on a missing value stops the program with ValueError: list.remove(x): x not in list. Check with in first.
